# Recorder — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What family is the Recorder in?", "woodwind"),
    ("How is the Recorder played?", "blown (fipple)"),
    ("What is family?", "woodwind"),
    ("What is origin?", "Europe, medieval"),
    ("What is how played?", "blown (fipple)"),
    ("What is range?", "F4-G6"),
    ("What is notable?", "The first instrument of millions of schoolchildren"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
